name: deep fryer pot
caption: A deep fryer pot with a deep cavity, a basket rim and two side handles. Four flat walls enclose a cavity; two angular handles bridge opposite facets. Faceted walls keep a constant thickness with a sealed base and a squared rim. Overall width is 1.10 times depth; height is 0.75 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous copper, dark brown, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
